svg.title: Tally on Mac, iPhone, and iPad
svg.desc: Editable device illustration featuring a Silver 16-inch MacBook Pro, a Burgundy iPhone 18 Pro Max, and a Purple 13-inch iPad Air. Each screen contains an unchanged Tally screenshot from a fictional scenario. The screen images and background are independently replaceable.
svg.metadata: Original illustration by Asher Bloom for Tally. Canvas 4000 × 2662. Editable screen-image IDs: mac-screen, iphone-screen, ipad-screen. Background ID: background-image.
